# Ashutosh Mahapatra

> Ashutosh Mahapatra is a freelance technology writer in Bhubaneswar, India. He writes research-led long-form articles and builds fully coded editorial pages for AI, fintech, SaaS and cybersecurity companies.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://ashutoshwrites.online/): Services, pricing, portfolio samples and contact details.
- [Blog](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog): Index of my long-form writing on AI, finance, content strategy, and human-led storytelling.
- [Selected Work](https://ashutoshwrites.online/work): Case-study view of my writing samples across AI, cybersecurity, fintech, and the creator economy.
- [Author: Ashutosh Mahapatra](https://ashutoshwrites.online/author/ashutosh-mahapatra): Biography, coverage areas, social profiles, and an archive of every published article.
- [AI Personal Finance 2026](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog/ai-personal-finance-2026): 18 sourced statistics, 5 structural trends and the risks most AI-finance coverage misses.
- [Human Creativity vs AI: The Authenticity Premium](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog/human-creativity-vs-ai-authenticity-premium-2026): Data on why audiences reject AI slop and how human creators win in 2026.
- [The Shadow AI Crisis: Why BYOA Is B2B SaaS's Next Data Nightmare](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog/byoa-shadow-ai-b2b-saas-2026): How AI agents inherit OAuth scope from platforms already approved, the BYOA risk chain, and a governance framework for enterprise security teams.
